amendments.change: Three additions, none of which changes the five-million target or any latency objective. A translation group is declared as one logical content item so nine languages do not inflate the headline figure. Content row volume is declared to scale with published locales so the storage forecast states it rather than discovering it. And undeclared_currency_conversions joins the integrity objectives at zero, which is what makes D10's audit rule a measured property instead of an intention.
amendments.not_changed: The envelope, the service level objectives, the workload mix, the reference installation shape and every topology requirement are untouched.

amendments.change: Adds the hot_sequence_commit operation class and its latency objective: sustained creates serialized on one gapless counter row, the single-sequence worst case whose throughput cost decision D1 requires the envelope to disclose.
amendments.not_changed: The five-million target, every existing objective, the workload mix and every topology requirement are untouched.

supersedes.amendment: The product owner selected the 5,000,000 logical-business-transaction daily profile as the Version 2 release qualification target. The 1,000,000 profile is retained as an early characterisation step only and is explicitly not a release claim. Staging the release claim down to 1,000,000 was considered and rejected.

logical_business_transaction.definition: One application command with one idempotent outcome and one atomic commit boundary, such as creating or posting one document.
logical_business_transaction.counting_rule: A document header plus its owned lines committed under one application invariant counts as exactly one LBT, never as one plus the line count.

document_line.definition: One owned or related line inside an aggregate.
document_line.counting_rule: Reported separately from LBTs; never substituted for them.

physical_row_mutation.definition: One database row insert, update or delete caused by an LBT, including header, lines, relations, revision, audit, idempotency, outbox, projection-source and supporting ledgers.
physical_row_mutation.counting_rule: Write amplification is the measured ratio PRM/LBT and must be published with every capacity result.

application_interaction.definition: One HTTP, CLI, MCP, administrator, portal, worker or scheduler request, read or write.

background_delivery.definition: One event dispatch, inbox consumption, job attempt, process step, report generation, projection update or export operation.

active_concurrency.definition: Requests or jobs executing simultaneously, not registered accounts and not logged-in sessions.

translation_group.definition: One logical content item together with its per-locale entries.
translation_group.counting_rule: A translation group is exactly ONE logical content item, never one per locale. Its per-locale entries are rows and are reported as rows, in the same way a 1,000-line document's lines are reported separately from the single LBT that committed them. Publishing nine languages does not multiply the headline figure and may never be reported as if it did.

counting_formulae.physical_row_writes_per_second: peak logical operations/s * write amplification * (1 + retry rate)
counting_formulae.prohibited: No document produced by this programme may publish an unqualified 'TPS' figure.

baseline.role: early characterisation only; not a release claim

stretch.role: breakpoint discovery; not automatically a supported claim

reference_installation_shape.role: The installation the enterprise envelope is measured on. The reference workload is a business group, not a single business, because that is the shape Version 2 supports.
reference_installation_shape.description: Four related businesses on one installation, selling different things, sharing selected master data by explicit choice, with accounting isolated per business and reportable in consolidated form.

examples: sites A, B and D share clients
sites A and C share products and price lists
all four sites share staff and person master data

ownership_scope_mix.site_owned: all accounting documents, ledgers and pay runs, plus each business's own definitions, records and operational data
ownership_scope_mix.group_owned: clients, products and services, price lists, and staff or person master data, in the proportions the workload generator declares

load_distribution.rule: The 5,000,000 daily logical business transactions are distributed across the four businesses, not concentrated in one. The generator declares the split and it is not uniform, because a real group has a dominant business.

consolidated_reporting.rule: The reference workload includes group-scoped consolidated reads running concurrently with transactional load, served through projections and counted in the report and export share of the workload mix.
consolidated_reporting.requirement: A consolidated read must never be served by relaxing write isolation, and its cost is measured alongside interactive traffic rather than in a quiet window.

inter_business_documents.rule: A transfer between two businesses of the group is two transactions coordinated by a durable event, never one. No transaction spans sites.
inter_business_documents.workload_share: included in the ordinary mutation share; each transfer counts as two logical business transactions plus one event delivery

expected_contention_effect.claim: The mutation fence is taken per site and definition installation, so four businesses running the same logical definition hold four distinct definition rows and four distinct installation rows. A group installation therefore partitions the definition-wide write hot spot into four independent fences.
expected_contention_effect.anchor: DoctrineBusinessRecordMutationFence::acquire() selects with WHERE h.site_identifier = ? on the site-scoped business_definitions table, joined to business_schema_installations, re-checking the installation's own site on the joined row.
expected_contention_effect.obligation: Characterisation runs measure a single-business installation and a four-business group installation, so the effect is reported as measured rather than claimed. The single-business figure remains the conservative published bound.

reference_installation_shape.out_of_scope: Multi-tenant service to unrelated tenants. That is version 3 or 4 and no figure in this contract is sized for it.

peak_shape.spike_handling: bounded backpressure and asynchronous processing; never silent partial work
peak_shape.integrity_requirement: no integrity loss and no unbounded backlog during either window

documents.standard_document: header plus up to 100 owned or related lines committed as one LBT
documents.large_document: header plus up to 1000 owned or related lines committed atomically through the same application invariant; HTTP and MCP may use an asynchronous operation envelope but may not split the business commit

content_row_multiplier.rule: Content row volume scales with the number of PUBLISHED locales in a translation group, not with the number of supported locales. An installation publishing three of the nine carries roughly three times the content rows of a single-language installation, and the storage forecast states the multiplier it was measured at.
content_row_multiplier.obligation: The dataset generator declares how many locales each translation group publishes, and the storage forecast publishes the resulting content-row figure alongside the single-language figure so the multiplier is visible rather than inferred.

catalogue_lookup_budget.rule: A message lookup is an array access against a compiled PHP catalogue served from the opcode cache. It adds NO file read and NO database query per message, and no per-request parse. The site- and organization-level override chain resolves once per request against a bounded cacheable set, because group and site overrides are administrative state rather than transactional state.
catalogue_lookup_budget.failure_condition: A render path issuing a query or a file read per message is a scale defect and fails the qualification, not merely a performance note.

localization.presentation_only: Locale affects presentation and formatting. It never affects a stored exact value, a checksum, an identifier, a machine error code, an audit action name or an ordering decision.

service_level_objectives.latency_exclusions: internet latency is excluded; all figures are measured at the application boundary

integrity_objective_notes.undeclared_currency_conversions: Decision D10. Counts every converted money amount presented on any surface — screen, report, export, API response or event payload — without its converted marker, the rate applied and the as-at instant of that rate. A run that presents one fails qualification; it is not reported with a caveat. Conversion is a presentation and reporting concern layered above stored exact values and never a mutation of them, so this objective is the companion to exact_value_drift rather than a relaxation of it.

availability_and_recovery.note: The baseline RPO of 5 minutes is only reachable with the point-in-time recovery capability adopted in the roadmap's decision D3. The currently shipped full-snapshot posture declares RPO equal to the backup interval (60 minutes on the documented reference schedule) in docs/operations/backup-restore.md. Until D3 ships, the 5-minute figure is a target, not a capability.

workload_mix.class: bounded reads, searches, lists, metadata discovery, portal and public views
ordinary create, update, action and relation mutations
1000 line aggregate documents or an equivalent line-volume stream
report, projection and export initiation, status and download
identity, approval, step-up, extension, schema, job and operational traffic

workload_mix_required_concurrent_activit: group-scoped consolidated reads across the four businesses, served through projections
inter-business transfers, each two transactions coordinated by a durable event
at least one noisy-neighbour site or organization attempting bounded expensive queries while unrelated sites stay inside their SLOs
workload_mix_rules: Percentages may be refined only by a recorded decision that restates the business consequence.
The mix must always retain large documents, policy-heavy queries, background effects, retention and operational traffic.
A benchmark composed only of primary-key reads or single-row inserts is not an enterprise qualification.

reference_single_node.role: developer and characterisation runs; never a release claim
reference_single_node.requirement: application, worker, Redis and database on one host with recorded vCPU, RAM, storage and IOPS

standard_enterprise.role: the topology the Version 2 enterprise claim is bound to
standard_enterprise.requirement: stateless application replicas, distinct worker pools per class, one authoritative primary database, bounded connection pools, recorded vCPU, RAM, storage class, IOPS, network round-trip time, TLS termination, binlog or WAL configuration and durability settings

high_availability.role: the topology the 99.95% and 1-minute RPO figures are bound to
high_availability.requirement: standard enterprise plus a synchronous or semi-synchronous replica, automated failover, and archive shipping proven by drill

mariadb_lts.depth: authoritative global coverage, full functional, concurrency, browser, deployment, backup and recovery tests, absolute and relative performance, soak and failover evidence

mysql_8_4_lts.depth: full functional, concurrency, browser, deployment, backup and recovery tests, absolute and relative performance, soak and failover evidence

postgresql_17.depth: release-blocking full functional, concurrency, browser, deployment, backup and recovery parity, performance regression and a documented capacity result

database_support.rule: Primary status adds MariaDB and MySQL depth. It never weakens PostgreSQL correctness and never permits an untested driver branch.
database_support.image_pinning: CI and qualification pin exact image digests. Floating tags may run as scheduled upgrade canaries but are never the sole reproducibility evidence for a release.

benchmark_method.hardware: versioned dedicated reference hardware; shared CI runners are never the authority for absolute throughput
benchmark_method.regression_rule: alert first, then fail on a p95 or memory regression greater than 10% or beyond two standard deviations, unless an approved budget change explains it
result_binding: dataset generator seed and age distribution
deterministic_pull_request_budgets: query count may not grow per line, item or result
bounded memory and encoded payload size at 1000 lines
indexed cursor pagination rather than deep offset
no full scan, sort or spill on a declared hot plan
migration plan size and runtime budget
statement and lock-duration budget for changed transactional paths
artifact and image size regression budget

scheduled_qualification.nightly: all three engines with a realistic aged dataset, 30 to 60 minutes at baseline and target subsets, repeated isolation, deadlock and lock-timeout cases, plan regression assertions
scheduled_qualification.weekly_or_release: 24-hour enterprise-rated run, 72-hour soak at 70% enterprise load, peak and spike and stress and breakpoint profiles, worker outage and backlog recovery, primary failover and replica lag, Redis loss, worker SIGKILL, network delay, downstream timeout, disk pressure, storage outage, schema and runtime generation transition during traffic, retention during load, fan-out 3 and 10 with slow and poison consumers, idempotency duplicates and conflicts, one hot legal-number sequence, noisy-neighbour tenant, and report, export and projection load alongside interactive traffic

structural_pass_conditions: query count does not grow per line or per result
no unapproved full scan, sort or spill on a hot plan
no missing or duplicate record, number, revision, audit, outbox row or external effect
lock waits, deadlocks and retries remain within declared budgets
queue and retention slopes return to zero
resident memory, connections, leases, temporary space and background processes stabilise after warm-up
catch-up meets the declared window after every injected fault
database CPU, connections and IOPS and worker utilisation stay below 70% normal and 85% peak, leaving at least 30% supported headroom

storage_forecast.hot_bytes_formula: live record bytes + line rows * measured line bytes + retained days * mutations/day * (revision + audit + idempotency + outbox + source-event bytes) + retained days * events/day * fan-out * inbox bytes
storage_forecast.worked_example: At 5,000,000 mutations per day a revisions-enabled event-producing workload adds roughly 5,000,000 daily rows to each of several independent ledgers before consumer fan-out; a 90-day window is about 450,000,000 rows in each unpruned stream. The document profile adds about 15,000,000 line rows per day.
required_publications: measured bytes per row and per index entry, per engine
write-ahead log or binary log and replica network amplification
backup size and time, and restore time
online index rebuild and upgrade temporary-space need
storage_forecast.temporary_capacity_rule: model up to 2x a hot-table size where the engine or operation can require it

applies_to: job attempts, process history, exports and projection rebuild sources
expired approvals, proofs, sessions and tokens

current_shipped_ceiling.verdict: below the enterprise ingress of at least 5,000,000 command-ledger rows per day; superseded in phase 5

scale_before_sharding.rule: Sharding is not introduced by default. Remove known global serialization, bound query and ledger growth, use stateless application replicas, scale worker pools, optimise schemas and indexes, and qualify a correctly configured primary database first.
preserved_partition_path: routing behind an application-owned persistence boundary
scale_before_sharding.condition_for_sharding: only when the measured target cannot be met economically on the approved topology, and only behind an architecture decision record that proves the migration, recovery, reporting and operational consequences
